style: 3D cartoon, Pixar, deadpan satire, bright white daylight

motion_rule: the camera circles the hero on the dense kelp wall and never stops, new shot size every beat, medium to close. ONE hero action per beat.

audio.lip_sync: the herring speaks on camera, mouth to the lens and opening on every syllable, nothing in it
